notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30355192/cab97eba66d16816261d7bf5b2e9aa5b3979e018.png[/img]
[h1]Since it's Halloween soon, we decided to get on the fun and prepare a special super creepy update to our VR game![/h1]

Spooky dancing skeletons, loads of ghosts, background tombstones and our original Pumpkin Spice Witch®, experience it all in our penguin fending, dynamite throwing, snowball throwing game.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added a new VHS cassette! Experience video comedy like its 1983!
    [*]New super spooky map! Overcome your fears and other players on the leaderboard!
    [*]Overall opitmisation and bugfixes.
[/list]

[h1]Happy Halloween![/h1]
